parrafo_1.es: GetBalanced Massage Therapy trabaja con cita previa en un consultorio tranquilo en Fort Lauderdale. El enfoque es terapeutico: tejido profundo, deportivo y tailandes, pensado para aliviar tension real, no solo relajar.
parrafo_1.en: GetBalanced Massage Therapy works by appointment in a calm studio in Fort Lauderdale. The focus is therapeutic: deep tissue, sports and Thai massage, built to relieve real tension, not just relax.

parrafo_2.es: Ademas del consultorio, ofrecen sesiones a domicilio en el sur de la Florida: la misma atencion profesional, donde te quede mejor.
parrafo_2.en: Beyond the studio, mobile sessions are available across South Florida: the same professional care, wherever works best for you.
